title: Aromatic Algerian Quinoa Tagine
description: This Algerian dish is a unique combination of quinoa, mirepoix, and cheese, featuring a bitter and savory flavor profile, and is often considered a hangover cure. It is a satvik-friendly option that can be enjoyed for lunch or dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the quinoa in a fine mesh strainer and drain well.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the quinoa, vegetable broth, and chopped dried apricots to the pot, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the quinoa is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the crumbled feta cheese until melted and well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
